## R54 round close (2026-07-24)

The field-change axis is settled in three verdicts across two days. H627 stands as the round's one win - a real, replicated, ingest-time seed-landing gain (+11.35pts recall@16 at alpha 0.6, split-half stable) - but H628 shows the gain does NOT convert on the shipped engine (identical reach and flips on the H651 widened region; the narrow-region window it might have exploited was closed by R58 the same morning), and H629 shows it is redundant with the incumbent anchor-reset lever (Jaccard 0.81, both surfaces 100% inside the widened region). H630 dies at its gate unfunded. The pattern now measured FOUR times in one day (H652, H653, H628, H629): every query-time lever proposed against the medium rung's miss surface recovers carriers the H651 widened region already contains. Disposition: the pooled index ships as a DASHBOARD instrument (a cheap ingest-time recall@16 gauge), not a wiring change; seeding stays raw dense; the retrieval-bridge value concentrates in anchor-reset + widened region + render_budget 1.0, now with H622's escalation gate (see R40x) bounding the walk cost. The round's residual routes where R58's did: extraction recall (ingest side) and cross-component connectivity.

## R40x round close (verdicts recorded 2026-07-24; executed 2026-07-14) - the anchor-reset arc converts, and a KILL supersedes a CONFIRM

Recording debt cleared: H619-H626 were registered and executed on 2026-07-14 but their verdicts sat only in `reports/experiments/r50/` until now. All six are FREE/deterministic; total spend on the arc remains zero GPU and zero LLM (H597's single attacher call excepted). Verdicts: **H620 CONFIRMED** (the money result), **H621 CONFIRMED** (premise refuted - collisions do not scale), **H619 INDETERMINATE-lean-positive** (superseded as a mechanism), **H623 KILLED-with-discovery**, **H624 KILLED-uncertifiable**, **H625 SKIPPED** (substrate), **H622 unlocked**, **H626 re-aimed**.

**The headline - reachability converts, and the two levers compose super-additively.** H620's 2x2 settles the open money question the R49 synthesis left: anchor-reset seeding plus the render_budget=1.0 defect fix flips **27 of 47** failing probes with **zero pass->fail regressions**, moving the frozen 132 panel from 85 to 112 passes (64.4% -> 84.8%). The dual arms earn their cost by forbidding the easy misattribution: render budget ALONE flips 7, anchor-reset adds the incremental +20 at budget 1.0 and +10 at budget 0.6, and 7 + 10 = 17 < 27, so the levers are not additive - retrieval gains stay INVISIBLE until the render budget stops trimming the newly reached blocks. That is the fourth and sharpest confirmation of the R49 finding that probes die at render trimming, and it converts the finding from a diagnosis into a shipping order. The residual is now clean and small: of 20 remaining fails, 10 are `carrier_not_retrieved` and 10 are `rendered_answer_absent`, and NONE is attributable to trimming.

**The methodological result - a KILL that supersedes a CONFIRM.** H619 hand-built a 49-term role-word stop-list from the 2wiki relation vocabulary and reached 0.8740. H623, registered on a different axis and KILLED there, reproduced **0.8740 exactly** as a lexicon-free max-gap adaptive-k seeder. The corpus-specific artifact is therefore retired in favour of the score-shape statistic that ties it, and the campaign records the rule: when a hand-curated lexicon and a distribution statistic land on the same number, ship the statistic - it carries no corpus binding. H619's deeper reading survives the supersede: the role-word DIAGNOSIS was right (72 spans dropped, `director` x46) but the residual is not mostly role-words - the 60 surviving off-gold picks are genuine names (`Maurice`, `Mother`, `Bodysong`), which no lexicon can touch.

**Three converging negatives, one pattern.** H623's CRC infeasibility, H624's lambda=0 wall, and H621's zero anchor-span collisions all say the same thing about the linker layer: the failure is NOT name ambiguity and NOT missing confidence signal. The ambiguity signal is demonstrably present (spline separates role-vs-clean at AUC 0.849, max-gap at 0.755) - it simply will not survive conformal certification at alpha=0.10, because gold anchors sit at rank >= 2 behind off-gold exact-match hubs that every cut-point detector keeps at rank 0. This is the H569 subject-vs-object failure resurfacing at the linker layer, and it makes the residual a RANKING problem inside a correct candidate list, not a candidate-generation or a calibration problem. Doctrine addition (third instance after H17 refuted and H181 confirmed-but-uncashable): score-shape carries real confidence information on this substrate and has now failed conformal certification three times - a proposal to gate anything on score shape must clear alpha-feasibility BEFORE its precision claim, not after.

**Scale is not the linker's risk.** H621 forecasts exact-rung coverage 0.9997 at the 6,118-doc rung (~12 colliding norms in ~40.5k entities) and measures zero collisions among the 171 resolved anchor spans at medium. The H568 attacher is not needed as a scale tie-breaker; H597's first-inserted policy is safe by measurement, not by luck.

**Unresolved and routed.** H625 leaves the native-index claim UNTESTED and blocked on the stalled dogfood ledger (2 nodes, `fsm_state=INITIALIZING`, ingest lock held) - and moot as scoped, since H623 killed its only consumer. H626 keeps its free substrate but is re-aimed off the pre-refuted precision bars onto the one axis H623 won. H622 inherits instantiated bars plus a warning: it must report walk invocations and flip attribution separately, or it will credit the render-budget fix to the escalation ladder. Wiring priority granted to anchor-reset + reset-region-union at render_budget=1.0.

## R55 - the construction/connectivity arm: is the archipelago binding, and is it reparable? (user-directed, registered 2026-07-24)

Opened by a convergence, not a proposal. Two mechanisms designed on opposite philosophies - R52-H598 (structure-first: thresholded anchor seeds, diffused to convergence) and R54-H627 (content-first: full graded similarity, diffused exactly one step) - failed identically on cross-component reach. That is not two coincidences but one algebraic fact: every operator in the family is a function of the normalized adjacency, and any analytic f(Ahat) is block-diagonal w.r.t. connected components, since u !~ w implies (Ahat^k)\_uw = 0 for every k. Heat kernel exp(-tL), PPR (I - alpha Ahat)^-1, one-step smoothing (1-alpha)I + alpha Ahat - all inherit it. **No member of the diffusion family can ever cross, so the reach ceiling is set at construction time.** The sharpened consequence: the ONLY component-crossing channel we have is raw dense cosine (it has no notion of the graph), and R47-H582 proved that channel sits at its information ceiling (~0.60, invariant across five encoders). One capped crossing channel, and every graph operator layered on it is blocked by algebra.

Vet pass (coordinator-run per `docs/hypothesis-vetting.md`): **V1 - the fence that matters.** "Graph repair" as a category is PARTLY KILLED already: H546 (repair-at-ingest buys latency, not recall), H571/H572 (the reachability audit is an instrument, not a predictor; the ingest-time-audit framing does not proceed), H579 (narrow ledgered repair 97.9% at 19.3% cost, probe-flip dead zone). Those tested **identity/fidelity** repair on an assumed-connected substrate. **Connectivity** repair - changing which nodes are mutually reachable at all - is a distinct object and untested; the registration is clean only under that distinction, and any later arm must re-cite these four or it re-derives them. **V2 - the prize is bounded, and H620 bounded it**: after both confirmed levers the residual is 20 fails, split 10 `carrier_not_retrieved` / 10 `rendered_answer_absent`, so the ENTIRE reach axis is worth at most ~10 probes of 132. At n=10 the H540 small-n discipline is mandatory - exact counts, no percentage-only reporting, no significance claims. **V3** - the census is itself the gate; if the residuals are not cross-component the arm does not open. **V4** - FREE, pure numpy over the existing H582/H627 offline cache; no Neo4j, no GPU, no LLM, no network. **V5** - retrieval-level, paired against the frozen 132. Numbering continues from R54's H630.

### R55-H631 CRUX - fragmentation census + residual cross-tab: is the reach axis binding, and is the fragmentation reparable?

- **Persona** - contrarian gate (the honest prior is that this arm does NOT open: H587/H556/H598 are a long record of structural findings that do not convert, and H620's residual is small enough that ranking may own all of it)
- **Grounding** - archipelago census from the R52 close (1,830 components, LCC 3,162 = 47.72%, 1,426 isolated nodes, ~34% of gold carriers outside the LCC); H627's measured ZERO cross-component recoveries on every arm; H620's `rru_b10` residual decomposition (10 `carrier_not_retrieved`); H621's finding that exact-name collision is ~zero, which means a name-identity twin across components would be a MERGE candidate, not a homonym
- **Hypothesis** - the fragmentation is one of three things and only one is reparable: **(a) identity split** - one real entity extracted as two nodes in two components (the H107 variance mechanism), where merging JOINS the components and repair is real; **(b) corpus coverage** - the bridging document is absent from the 1,000-doc rung, where no repair helps and the lever is rung size; **(c) singleton noise** - once-mentioned leaf entities, where neither applies. The decisive question is orthogonal to all three: are H620's 10 `carrier_not_retrieved` residuals actually cross-component at all?
- **Prediction** - registered honestly as uncertain in direction; the informative split is the cross-tab, not the census
- **Acceptance bar** - **ARM-OPENS** if >= 5 of the 10 residuals are cross-component AND >= 50% of the implicated components carry an (a)-type identity twin (reparable by merge). **ARM-NARROW** if cross-component >= 5 but the reparable fraction < 50% - the fragmentation is coverage or singleton, so the lever is rung size or extraction recall, NOT repair, and the arm routes away from graph work. **ARM-DEAD-ON-PANEL** if < 3 of 10 are cross-component - reach is not binding on the current residual, the remaining misses are RANKING failures, and they route to H630 rather than to a construction round
- **Vet** - V1 fenced against H546/H571/H572/H579 (identity repair, distinct object) per the round intro; V2 n=10, H540 discipline; V4 FREE; V5 harness must reproduce H627's constants bit-exact before any new number is believed

- **Status** - **ARM-DEAD-ON-PANEL (2026-07-24) - the construction/connectivity arm does NOT open, and the round's own framing was wrong in a more interesting way than the bar anticipated.** All four sanity constants reproduce exactly (0.6012 recall, 1,830 components, LCC 3,162 / 47.72%, 1,426 isolated). Part A independently verifies the R52 figure: **99 of 286 unique gold-carrier nodes lie outside the LCC = 0.3462**; 68 components hold a carrier (LCC + 67 others, 62 of size >= 2). **The decisive cross-tab reads cross-component 0/10, same-component-not-retrieved 0/10, carrier-absent-from-graph 10/10** - so ARM-DEAD-ON-PANEL fires at its < 3 threshold, and the archipelago, while real and large, is NOT binding on a single one of H620's remaining reach failures. Part B (recorded but now secondary): of the 67 non-LCC carrier components, identity-split (a) reads **29/67 under strict token containment, 15/67 under the tight cos>=0.90 / fuzzy>=0.90 / identical-norm set** - the class is highly signal-definition-sensitive (naive substring containment would have inflated it to 61/67 on a 42% control base rate and was correctly discarded), so no "X% reparable" claim may be quoted without its signal; only **12/29 (tight 7/15)** have a twin in the LCC, so most merges would join two small islands rather than reach the mainland. ### R55-H632 CRUX - the gold-join is pessimistically biased and the whole carrier-recall metric family inherits it (promoted straight out of H631)

- **Persona** - referee / instrument audit (H631 surprise #2, promoted because it contaminates the measuring stick rather than any one result)
- **Grounding** - VERIFIED AT SOURCE, not inferred: `hits_for()` in `scripts/experiments/r54_h627_neighborhood_pool.py` scores a carrier as hit **only** on exact `tnorm` set-membership, and the carrier list is built from every supporting-fact title **regardless of `in_graph`**. H631 Part A measures **38 of 326 carrier rows that do not join the graph at all** - those 38 sit in the denominator and can NEVER enter the numerator, so the harness ceiling is **288/326 = 0.8834, not 1.0**. In the one sample where the join failures were inspected individually (H631 Part C), **7 of 10 were present in the graph and already retrieved** under a paren-stripped or spelling variant. The identical exact-title join defines H501 (0.5982), H582 (0.6012 and its embedder-invariance bound), H597 (reachability 0.8661), H627 (0.6012 -> 0.7147) and H620's `carrier_not_retrieved` bucket
- **Hypothesis** - a normalization-hardened gold join (paren-strip, case/punctuation/diacritic fold, `and`/`&` and spelling variants, alias table, fuzzy tie-break above a pre-committed ratio with manual adjudication of the accepted set) recovers a material share of the 38 non-joining rows as genuine in-graph carriers, RAISING every level in the metric family while leaving the recorded VERDICTS intact
- **Prediction** - directional and pre-committed: levels rise, deltas move little. Arithmetic reason to expect the second half - an unjoinable carrier scores 0 in EVERY arm, so it is a shared constant in the denominator; absolute pp deltas are compressed by ~288/326 = 0.883 and would GROW by ~13% relative on a joinable-only denominator (H627's +9.51pt -> ~+10.8pt), which changes no sign and flips no verdict
- **Acceptance bar** - CONFIRMED if >= 15 of the 38 non-joining rows resolve to a graph node under the hardened join AND every re-measured verdict keeps its sign (levels restated, verdicts unchanged); KILLED if < 5 resolve (the 7/10 rate in H631's residual was a small-sample fluke and the 38 are genuinely absent - which would instead promote an extraction-recall finding). **HARD GUARD: the hardened join must be validated in the direction that can only LOSE us credit** - measure its false-merge rate on a held-out set of DISTINCT gold titles that must NOT collapse (`Inherent Vice (film)` vs `Inherent Vice (novel)` is the canonical adversarial pair and is present in this data); any join that merges a genuine distinction is rejected outright, since a recall metric that over-credits is worse than one that under-credits
- **Vet** - V1 clean (no prior gold-join audit; DEF-14 is the closest precedent - a harness/engine parity defect of exactly this class, and its resolution pattern applies: fix the instrument, stamp the version, keep old runs comparable only against matched-version runs); V2 the 38 are enumerable and adjudicable by hand, so this is exact rather than sampled; V4 FREE offline; V5 **every restated number must be published as a PAIR (old-join, new-join) with the join version stamped**, and no historical verdict may be silently overwritten - supersede in place with a back-reference per the append-only rule
- **Experiment** - FREE; enumerate all 38, adjudicate each by hand, then re-measure the family; `reports/experiments/r55/h632-gold-join-*.json`
- **Status** - **CONFIRMED (2026-07-24, user go-ahead same day) - the join hardens cleanly, every sign holds, and the adjudication CORRECTS H631's headline.** All sanity constants reproduced exactly (0.6012; 326/288/38; meanpool 0.6963/0.7147; reachability 0.8661 = 110/127 faithfully replayed, so the reachability family was re-measured rather than excluded; PPR control measured at 0.6564 old). GUARD FIRST, as registered: **zero false merges on all three rungs** across 324 distinct gold titles, zero of the 288 exact rows remapped; the adversarial `Inherent Vice (film)` lands on the Film-typed node while the coexisting `(novel)` node is not a gold title - and the guard-teeth counterfactual is reported honestly: even an unconditional paren-strip collides on 0 gold-title pairs in this data, so the discipline's protection is latent here, not a demonstrated catch. LADDER (rung-ordered, per-rung, never blended): r1 paren-strip 27 resolved -> 23 accepted + 4 ADJUDICATE-PENDING; r2 fold 1 accepted (`Track & Field News` spacing typo); r3 fuzzy>=0.92 1 accepted (`Joanna`->`Johanna Elisabeth of Holstein-Gottorp`, 0.986); **25/38 accepted**, 9 unresolved - including all 3 of H631's genuinely-absent (best fuzzy 0.82/0.886/0.80, all below the pre-committed 0.92; no rung ever claimed one - no red flags). ## R56 - entity-linking layer fanout: rank the list, harden the join, recover the absent (user-directed research + fanout, registered 2026-07-24)

Opened by user directive off the R55/R40x wave: cross-reference the linking-layer findings with the external literature, then fan out. Research brief `reports/experiments/r56/entity-linking-research-brief-20260724.md` (subagent research; 3 new papers filed - ELQ, BLINK, neural-EL survey - 13 already-filed reused). The literature CORROBORATES every fence rather than contradicting one: (1) the field never makes the candidate cut precise - BLINK retrieves wide (Recall@64 82-93%) and pushes precision into a stage-2 re-ranker, ELQ enumerates ALL spans; H626's anti-alignment is field doctrine restated; (2) no peer NIL signal is curve geometry - priors, magnitudes, trained classifiers, cross-encoders only - independently confirming the closed score-shape axis (H623/H624/H626); (3) type-constrained candidate matching is standard practice (ReFinED, survey) - the H632 Camille gate is a missing standard gate, not a hack; (4) **THE EVAL-JOIN ANSWER: no peer joins gold supporting-fact titles to graph nodes.** HippoRAG/HippoRAG-2 evaluate passage recall@k + answer EM/F1; GraphRAG/LightRAG use LLM-judged answer quality; 2wiki/HotpotQA/MuSiQue score answer EM/F1 + supporting-sentence/triple overlap. Our carrier-title->node join is a self-imposed, strictly-harder diagnostic instrument peers do not run - our carrier-join failures are diagnostic signals invisible to peers, and our headline carrier numbers are NOT apples-to-apples with published passage-recall figures. THE REFRAME (brief surprise, adopted at registration): the NIL/ambiguity-detection axis is likely MIS-POSED for KGF - H621 proved the residual is hub-outranks-gold inside a CORRECT candidate list, so the missing stage is a RANKING pass, not abstention; genuine NIL exists only for absent golds (extraction recall) and truly unlinkable spans. B-axis arms therefore register GATED. Standing caveat for every encoder arm: self-extracted nodes have NO descriptions (the entity-tower input ELQ/BLINK/ReFinED all assume) - candidate text must be synthesized from incident-edge context, budgeted and measured as its own sub-result. Declined without registration (no-slop): the brief's C3 query-time neighbourhood variant resolution - a cost refactor of the shipped ladder carrying no recall claim. Numbering H633-H643.

### R56-H633 CRUX - hub-demotion prior inside the anchor list (the stage-2 ranking gate, FREE)

- **Persona** - exploit (the field's stage-2 disambiguation in its cheapest form: an entity-popularity prior)
- **Grounding** - H621/H623: gold sits at rank >= 2 behind off-gold exact-match generic hubs inside a CORRECT candidate list (the 60 surviving off-gold picks post-stoplist are genuine-name collisions, not homonyms); the neural-EL survey assigns exactly this failure to disambiguation priors; H626 BOUNDS THE DESIGN - anchor count must not shrink (surplus anchors are useful reset mass), so this arm REORDERS within the kept set, never cuts

- **Prediction** - off-gold picks down >= 30% vs the max-gap incumbent census; reach_all >= 0.8740 paired with zero unoffset regressions
- **Acceptance bar** - CONFIRMED per prediction (ships as the anchor-ranking pass; H634 proceeds as the escalation comparison); KILLED if paired reachability DROPS - which would extend H626's inversion from anchor COUNT to anchor IDENTITY (hubs as load-bearing reset mass) and is recorded as doctrine either way

## R59 - associative memory priced against the shipped engine: the Hopfield frame (user-directed research + fanout, registered 2026-09-02)

User-directed fanout on Hopfield-network approaches for the retrieval bridge and for encoding knowledge in the graph. Research was executed FIRST and registration deliberately held behind it: 33 papers downloaded and digested into `references/papers/`, findings at `reports/experiments/r59/hopfield-grounding-20260902T080505Z.md`.

**Family-wide pre-registered NULL.** One modern Hopfield update is `xi' = X^T softmax(beta X xi)`, which is simultaneously one attention operation, the Universal Hopfield (similarity, separation, projection) triple, and - as beta grows - top-1 dense retrieval; with a threshold separation it is top-k, constructed in the literature as the top-K modern Hopfield model. The shipped `raw dense@16` IS that triple. A Hopfield formulation escapes the shipped engine under exactly FOUR conditions: (1) the pattern bank is not the retrieval index; (2) the output re-enters the cue, which is real only in the badly-separated regime where the fixed point is a blend; (3) the separation is structured rather than pointwise; (4) the outer-product weight matrix's entries become EDGES - the single place the family leaves dense retrieval entirely, and the only escape from block-diagonality, since every analytic `f(A_hat)` is component-local but `A_hat` itself is not fixed. Any arm that does not name its escape condition is the null.

Grounding moved the round materially. Of eight drafted mechanisms, three are recorded dead at registration (including the coordinator's own drafted crux), one narrows to a non-Hopfield seeder variant, and the surviving weight shifted from the retrieval bridge to the ENCODING side - which is where the post-R58 residual actually lives (12 golds absent from the graph, 4 cross-component, against a closed query-time frontier). Vet pass (coordinator-run per `docs/hypothesis-vetting.md`): **V1** - the family collides with H597 fuse-add, H652 query-as-node and H653 gated round-2 on the retrieval side, which is exactly what kills the region-cued and iterated arms; the encoding arms collide with nothing registered. **V2** - the addressable in-graph probe surface on this rung is 6 rows of 132, far inside the H540 band (~+-8.5pp at n=132), so every retrieval-side bar demands an outright gain and the structural arms report structure first, exact counts always. **V3** - two free instruments (H657, H660) gate the three arms that would cost anything. **V4** - five of seven arms are FREE offline replay; only H662 needs the GPU. **V5** - retrieval-level scoring against the frozen 132, and the AAR inductive null forces a leakage-clean split on H661. Numbering H657-H663.

### R59-H657 Separation-certificate scale forecast (the free instrument, runs first)

- **Persona** - instrument (atlas-before-mechanisms: R57's atlas priced R58 in one pass; this prices H658/H663 the same way)
- **Grounding** - Ramsauer Theorem 5 inverts to a requirement that is distribution-free in the patterns because it depends only on observables: `Delta_required(N, eps) = (1/beta) ln(2(N-1)M/eps)`; on l2-normalised vectors the observable `Delta_i = 1 - cos(i, nearest competitor)`. The capacity theorems (`N >= sqrt(p) c^((d-1)/4)`, `2^(d/2)`) assume randomly chosen patterns and do NOT transfer to correlated text embeddings - exact asymptotic work confirms the capacity constant is distribution-dependent, so there is no universal N. H621 (anchor-collision forecast at the 6,118-doc rung) is the precedent shape
- **Hypothesis** - the empirical `Delta` distribution over current entity prototypes, shifted by `ln(r)/beta` for the medium-to-large rung ratio `r ~= 46`, forecasts a materially non-zero percentile of prototypes falling below the retrieval certificate at the large rung
- **Prediction** - report the `Delta` percentile curve and the projected below-certificate percentile at `r = 46` (the requirement rises by `3.83/beta`); under 1% means identity is scale-safe on this axis, over 10% means the large rung needs a separation intervention before ingest

### R59-H661 Hyperedge associative overlay - the only arm that changes the adjacency (GATED on H660)

- **Persona** - exploit the one structural escape: every analytic `f(A_hat)` is component-local, but writing edges changes `A_hat`
- **Grounding** - AAR reports HotpotQA passage recall@5 0.831 -> 0.916 (+8.6 points) with **+28.5 points on hard questions where the dense baseline fails**, MuSiQue +10.1, downstream +6.4 exact match, at 3.7 ms per query. SiReRAG independently confirms an entity-relatedness index complements a similarity index on this exact benchmark family at roughly +1.9 average F1. Simplicial Hopfield shows a small random SUBSET of setwise connections outperforms an all-pairwise network of equal size - selectivity dominates volume, and a chunk's entity set should be one hyperedge rather than its pairwise expansion
- **Hypothesis** - writing baseline-subtracted chunk-local entity sets as HYPEREDGES (never pairwise expansion) merges components and flips probes the widened region cannot reach
- **Prediction** - component count falls AND the frozen panel gains: >= 2 net flips paired with zero pass-to-fail regressions
- **Acceptance bar** - CONFIRMED only if BOTH structure and flips move; KILLED if the LCC grows while flips stay flat - that is noise, and the project already carries one unread similarity-edge layer
- **Vet** - V1 distinct from H546 (repair-at-ingest buys latency, not recall) and H571/H572/H579 (identity and fidelity repair on an assumed-connected substrate); CONNECTIVITY repair is the untested object per the R49 fence; V2 the addressable surface on this rung is at most the 4 cross-component plus 2 deep rows, far inside the n=132 band - the honest PRIMARY readout is structural, the flip count secondary and reported as exact counts; V3 H660 is the oracle gate; V4 FREE to simulate against the cached region before any write, GPU only to materialise; V5 the decisive published null is AAR's INDUCTIVE variant showing no significant improvement - the transductive gain came from co-occurrence as supporting facts FOR QUESTIONS, i.e. question supervision, not generic textual co-occurrence, so a leakage-clean split is mandatory and the frozen 132 cannot both teach and judge. Training on similar-but-non-associated pairs is measured to degrade retrieval BELOW baseline
- **Experiment** - FREE simulation first, then GATED write; `reports/experiments/r59/h661-hyperedge-overlay-*.json`
- **Status** - **GATE OPEN (2026-09-14)** - H660 re-run: (b) = 22,910 cross-component non-adjacent co-occurring pairs, 3 of the 4 residual cross-component gold rows bridgeable by at least one such pair. Not dispatched: the FREE simulation and the gated write both wait for the user's word (the write mutates the scratch rung, never a keeper). Sizing caveat carried from H660: `w_assoc` does not rank on this rung (independence baseline near zero), so the selectivity the hypothesis relies on must come from the hyperedge structure and a stated selection rule, not from the weight - the simulation spec states that rule before it runs

### R59-H662 Stored question index with fusion - changing what the dense channel matches against (GATED on GPU-1; absorbs H656)

- **Persona** - exploit the representation axis, the only axis untouched by temperature, k, or the walk
- **Grounding** - QuOTE reports SQuAD top-1 context accuracy 67.11% -> 77.65%, Natural Questions 32.92% -> 38.00%, MultiHop-RAG full-match@20 22.50% -> 35.00%, best at ~10 questions per chunk, 141 ms per query against HyDE's 1,274 ms. doc2query lifts MS MARCO MRR@10 18.4 -> 21.5 and recall@1000 85.3% -> 89.3%. Doc2Query-- shows relevance-filtering the generated questions gives up to +16% effectiveness at -33% index size and -23% query time; hallucinated generated queries actively harm retrieval. Doc2Query++ scales 0 to 600 questions per document and finds performance PEAKS near 100 then degrades, and that appending generated queries to passage text HARMS dense retrieval - the fix is dual-index fusion
- **Hypothesis** - a SEPARATE question index (never concatenation), ~10 relevance-filtered questions per chunk, fused with the raw dense channel, lifts bridge-carrier seed landing above the 0.26 hit-rate
- **Prediction** - bridge hit-rate lift >= 10pp with first-hop hit-rate (0.915) not regressed, and >= 3 net panel flips paired
- **Acceptance bar** - CONFIRMED per prediction; KILLED at < 3 net flips or ANY first-hop regression; automatic KILL if implemented by concatenation rather than a separate fused index
- **Vet** - V1 folds and SUPERSEDES H656 (same mechanism class, now grounded and narrowed); distinct from H371 and H652, which put queries in the WALK - this puts questions in the INDEX; V2 the >= 3 bar is the threshold H651 cleared, paired on the frozen 132; V4 GPU - question generation is the cost, riding the same GPU-1 window as the H637 gleaning re-run; V5 the STRUCTURAL null is pre-registered: questions generated FROM a chunk describe that chunk, so a bridge entity absent from that chunk's own text will not appear in its questions - if the bridge lift lands under 10pp this is the reason, and it bounds the mechanism permanently. Note also that the published headline gains are single-hop, with multi-hop absolute numbers modest despite large relative gains
- **Experiment** - GPU; `reports/experiments/r59/h662-question-index-*.json`
- **Status** - **REGISTERED (2026-09-02)**, GATED on GPU-1 arbitration

### R59-H663 Daydreaming prototype consolidation - turning extraction variance into prototype formation (GATED on H658)

- **Persona** - contrarian (the literature's one method that makes correlated, noisy patterns a capacity GAIN rather than a capacity loss)
- **Grounding** - daydreaming alternates Hebbian reinforcement with non-destructive erasure of the spurious attractors the dynamics reach unprompted; on correlated data it converts correlation into a capacity gain, and on MNIST the resulting attractors sit close to CLASS PROTOTYPES. The campaign's identity regime is exactly correlated-and-noisy (71% extraction variance), and prototype-formation theory reports that at noise `p >= 0.3` plain dynamics give weak spurious attractors instead of prototypes
- **Hypothesis** - a daydream pass over the entity prototype bank raises the separation margin of the surface-variant clusters H107 identified, moving prototypes above the H657 certificate that currently fall below it
- **Prediction** - the below-certificate percentile from H657 falls materially after the pass, with no true-merge loss on the adjudicated gold-join
- **Acceptance bar** - CONFIRMED on a margin gain with no adjudicated regression; KILLED if margins move but adjudicated merge decisions do not change - the pass is then cosmetic
- **Vet** - V1 no prior KGF arm attempts prototype consolidation in embedding space; the R29 identity-stack work operated on the Bayesian posterior; V2 the readout is a distribution shift, not a probe count, so it escapes the n=132 band, but any merge-decision claim reverts to exact counts; V3 H657 and H658 both price it - if the certificate is not load-bearing in H658, this has nothing to lift; V4 FREE, numpy over the cached prototype bank; V5 non-destructive by construction - the pass proposes, the adjudicated gold-join judges
- **Experiment** - FREE; `reports/experiments/r59/h663-daydream-consolidation-*.json`
- **Status** - **GATE CLOSED (2026-09-14) - by the registered V3 condition, not run, zero spend.** H658 KILLED: the certificate is a re-parameterisation of the cosine screen, not load-bearing, and the vet line above states "if the certificate is not load-bearing in H658, this has nothing to lift". Second, the target is unmeasurable on this rung: the cured bank holds 9 hand-adjudicated surviving near-duplicate pairs (H658 extension), under the 30-pair floor, so a consolidation pass has no adjudicable merge-decision readout. Reopens only on a rung with a purpose-built adjudicated duplicate set of >= 30 pairs

### R59 recorded-dead (vetted out at registration, 2026-09-02)

Three drafted mechanisms are recorded dead rather than discarded, each with the grounding that killed it.

- **Region-cued associative completion (the coordinator's own drafted crux)** - V1 kill. Vector pseudo-relevance feedback computes `alpha q + (1 - alpha) mean(feedback)`; region-cueing is that operation at **alpha = 0** with the deepest available pool, the strictly more aggressive form of what this campaign already killed twice (H597 fuse-add -1.6pp, H652 query-as-node -2 flips), and the published PRF-pitfalls result is that dense vector PRF helps only when the original query keeps majority weight and the feedback pool is shallow. Independently, mixed-memory theory CONSTRUCTS configurations `sign(sum_mu m_mu xi^mu)` from superposed patterns and proves they are stable states of the energy, retrievable by the dynamics exactly as real patterns are, with count of order `3^M`. The cue therefore lands in a spurious basin by theorem, not by tuning. Re-proposable only on a rung where the pattern bank is provably well-separated
- **Iterated Hopfield updates** - V1 kill, consistent with H653 (+0 flips). Ramsauer Theorem 4 bounds the update's Jacobian, making the map a CONTRACTION for well-separated patterns, so iteration lands epsilon-close after one step and further steps move nothing; in the badly-separated regime it averages toward the blend. No published in-between regime exists for retrieval; the one paper mapping the transition describes a narrow band between gain thresholds and collapse
- **Universal-Hopfield separation sweep** - V3 kill, but the REDUCTION is recorded as doctrine because it is load-bearing for the whole family (stated in the round preamble above). Every published separation sweep is image pixel-space reconstruction, with no text-embedding retrieval sweep on record, and the axis is monotone toward sharpness (max > softmax at high beta > softmax at beta=1 > low-order polynomial > identity) - the direction a top-k retriever has already taken. Recorded corollary: **PERSONALIZED PAGERANK IS OUTSIDE THE FRAMEWORK** - Millidge's own work shows PPR and the successor representation are isomorphic, both the stationary distribution of a random walk, i.e. the resolvent of a discounted transition operator, while Universal Hopfield is explicitly a single-shot framework. The walk and the dense channel are NOT two settings of one mechanism. Recorded corollary two: the literature's live axis is **similarity**, not separation - Manhattan beats dot product with the gap growing with data complexity, and U-Hop makes separation trainable in a learned kernel space
- **Standing nulls on the axis** - any future Hopfield arm must clear these before claiming the frame itself pays: the CLOOB ablation reports that both InfoLOOB and InfoNCE WITH a Hopfield layer decrease performance against plain InfoNCE on most tasks, the authors naming it underfitting of modern Hopfield networks; Graph Hopfield Networks price their memory at ~2.0pp with a memory-disabled ablation that already beats baselines; DeepRC's headline 0.846 +- 0.223 against SVM 0.827 +- 0.210 sits inside the spread

### R59 wave-1 close (2026-09-14)

Two of three FREE arms decided; the third is blocked on infrastructure, not on evidence. **H659 KILLED** as registered - adaptive-k nucleus seeding is either degenerate (the cap binds on every probe and the arm is fixed dense@64 at +1, inside the band) or net-zero-to-negative, which closes the metastable-region reading of the H651 rule: the region rule has no continuous temperature form worth shipping. **H657 delivered** its curve and, in doing so, confirmed the family's own reduction from the data side - the separation certificate is a margin-to-runner-up threshold whose knob is beta, usable only at beta >= 64, with the N-awareness worth ~0.06 of margin between rungs; H658 is re-priced to run as a swept margin rule judged at matched merge volume. The left tail (p1-p10, `Delta` 0.06-0.21) is the extraction-variance cluster and is H663's target, so H663's gate on H658 stands. **H660 PREMISE-FAILED**: no medium-rung Neo4j instance exists on the host and the chunk->entity mapping was never persisted offline; the H661 gate is undecided until the medium dump is restored, which stands up infrastructure and is therefore a user decision. Ledger: one arm killed, one instrument delivered with a re-pricing, one arm blocked; zero GPU/LLM spend; one process defect recorded (the offline cache lacks the chunk->entity mapping).

### R59 wave-2 close (2026-09-14)

Both pending decisions landed the same day, on the user's word: the medium rung was restored from the July dump into a read-only scratch instance, and the re-priced H658 ran. **H658 KILLED**: the margin-to-runner-up certificate is a re-parameterisation of the shipped 0.82 cosine screen - false merges within 3 of the fixed rule on 312 candidates at every matched volume, mixed sign - and the identity side of the round is closed with the constant in place. The registered true-merge surface turned out to be empty by construction (the v3 gold-join is a title -> node function), which is the durable finding: a merge-precision hypothesis on this rung needs a purpose-built adjudicated duplicate set of at least 30 pairs before registration; the cured bank holds 9. **H663 GATE CLOSED** by its own registered V3 condition. **H660 GATE OPEN**: 22,910 chunk-local co-occurring pairs are neither adjacent nor intra-component, and 3 of the 4 residual cross-component gold rows are bridgeable by one, so **H661 opens** - the one arm in the family that changes the adjacency rather than reading it. Two cautions travel with it: the baseline-subtracted weight does not rank on this rung, so selection must be structural, and AAR's inductive null means a non-trivial count opens the arm without sizing it. Ledger for the round so far: H657 instrument, H659 killed, H658 killed, H663 gate closed, H660 census delivered, H661 open and undispatched, H662 waiting on GPU-1 arbitration; zero GPU/LLM spend; one process fix landed (chunk -> entity cache) and one recorded (identity arms need their own duplicate surface).
